raw.description:
Wishpond Technologies currently has the position of Account Director available, and we’re excited to tell you about it!

OVERVIEW

We're looking for a full-time Marketing Account Director to lead a team of Account Managers. As a digital marketing leader, you will own the quality and performance of the marketing work your delivers for our SMB clients.
This is a hands-on marketing leadership role, not a sales role. You won't carry a quota or sell new business. Instead, your focus lies at the intersection of strong client relationships, setting campaign strategy, reviewing the actual marketing work your team produces, coaching Account Managers to deliver stronger results, and making sure every client sees measurable ROI from their campaigns. You should be someone who can do the marketing work and is ready to lead a team that does it at scale. In collaboration with company leadership, the Account Director is responsible for Wishpond Technologies' success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5–8 Account Managers who run day-to-day digital marketing delivery for SMB clients.
  • Raise the bar on campaign quality and marketing execution across the team, you can do the work, and you teach it.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Run kickoff calls for new clients — set expectations, align on budgets, and build the digital marketing strategy (channels, targeting, funnel, and ROI benchmarks) for the engagement.
  • Partner with the ads team to turn that strategy into executable paid media, SEO, email, and landing-page plans, and deliver them to the client with confidence.
  • Stay close to strategy as campaigns run, adjusting based on performance data.
  • Own the quality and performance of the marketing your team ships, review assets, copy, campaigns, and reporting before anything reaches a client.
  • Turn campaign data into proactive optimizations that drive demonstrable client ROI.
  • Spot patterns across the team and fix them at the system level, not one client at a time.
  • Lead your team in using our full AI tool stack to deliver high-quality work at a pace traditional agencies can't match.
  • Own the quality bar on AI-assisted assets, copy, and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of what's possible with AI, bring new applications and workflows to the team as the tools evolve.
  • Contribute to the broader evolution of Wishpond's service model, processes, and standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years in digital marketing, account management, or client strategy, with at least 2 years in a leadership, team lead, or senior supervisory role. Experience in an SMB‑focused agency or SaaS environment is a strong asset.
  • Hands-on experience designing and executing full-funnel marketing strategies, including paid media (Meta/Google Ads), SEO, email marketing, and landing pages/CRO.
  • A deep understanding of what drives marketing ROI for small and mid-sized businesses, with a proven track record of retaining and growing client relationships.
  • Experience building or refining onboarding and client success processes.
  • A collaborative, highly effective communicator, comfortable and credible in front of both clients and your team.
  • Experience leading senior client-facing conversations, including kickoffs, budgets, and strategy.
  • Strong coaching instincts and a genuine interest in developing people.
  • Comfort working across a full AI tool stack, and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and owning outcomes
  • As part of a diverse team, the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Must be technical, analytical, results-driven and have the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Organized, administratively strong, and have solid writing, phone, and general communication skills.
  • Background in paid media, SEO, email, or full-funnel campaign strategy.
  • Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) — an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Fluent in English; most of our clients are based in the US and Canada

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This is a 100% remote position, and the individual could be based anywhere outside of Canada.
  • Given the nature of this role, it is expected that the successful candidate will provide their own workstation, computer, and headset and have a fast and reliable internet connection. Certain roles will be required to utilize and or download company-approved software.
  • The individual must be willing to work standard business hours in either the Pacific Time Zone or the Eastern Time Zone.
  • Due to the nature of this role, we may verify backgrounds, including conducting employment references, criminal records, and credit checks.
  • Once hired, the successful candidate must provide a governmental photo ID and proof of residential address as part of the onboarding process.

GREAT REASONS TO APPLY FOR THIS ROLE

  • Fully remote position allowing you to work from your home anywhere in the world !
  • Exciting and dynamic environment with a great leadership team
  • Comprehensive training program and regular performance reviews to facilitate your success
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and proven abilities
  • Great referral programs with incentives and bonuses
  • Unbelievable product discounts when you use our products for your own business
  • A global workforce of multi-cultural and talented colleagues
  • A close-knit operation with amazing growth opportunities for your personal development
  • A high-growth SaaS technology company publicly traded on the TSX Venture Exchange
  • Corporate headquarters in beautiful Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

ABOUT US

Founded in 2009, Wishpond is a rapidly growing technology company providing digital marketing solutions targeted at small businesses. The cloud-based platform includes landing pages, social promotions, website pop-ups, online forms, and lead activity tracking. Wishpond has a dedicated team of professional project managers, designers, copywriters, and developers who provide marketing services tailored to our individual clients.
Wishpond serves over 3,000 customers in various industries and sizes, from startups to large Fortune 500 companies. Wishpond has a rapidly growing global headcount and continues to hire dedicated and qualified employees and contractors who have what it takes to scale a successful software company.
To learn more about Wishpond Technologies, please visit our website or any of our social media platforms:
  • Website: www.wishpond.com
  • Instagram: @wishpondofficial
  • Twitter: Wishpond
  • Youtube: Thewishpond

raw.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

The Principal Platform Engineer supports QVC, and serves as a senior technical leader responsible for shaping the future of our enterprise database and data platform environment. You will combine engineering expertise with strategic influence to ensure our database platforms are scalable, secure, resilient, and built to enable fast, reliable delivery across both on-premises and cloud ecosystems.

Where You'll Work

This role is remote; job seekers must reside in one of the following states to be considered: PA, NJ, DE. This role may require you to be on site in West Chester, PA as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design, evolution, and modernization of enterprise database platforms across cloud and on-premises environments, with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and security.

  • Define database engineering standards, best practices, and automation approaches that improve operational consistency and accelerate delivery.

  • Partner with architecture, engineering, analytics, and product teams to deliver resilient database solutions aligned to business and technology priorities.

  • Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, high availability/disaster recovery, and complex issue resolution across critical database environments.

  • Mentor engineers and act as a thought leader, helping elevate engineering standards and modern database practices across the organization.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in database engineering, platform engineering, or data platform engineering within complex enterprise environments.

  • Deep expertise in relational and NoSQL databases, including strong experience with Azure database services, database modernization, and cloud adoption.

  • Proven success in performance tuning, automation, HA/DR, security, and governance, with the ability to influence stakeholders and mentor technical teams.

Our Total Rewards package includes benefits you’ll love such as competitive compensation, paid time off, an employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, and amazing company discounts! In our US market, you can also expect health care benefits starting on day 1, 401(k), and tuition reimbursement benefits.

QVC Group is committed to inclusion and belonging for all and ensuring that our workplace provides equal employment opportunities for all team members and candidates and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations. As an equal opportunity employer, QVC Group is committed to a barrier-free employment process. If you need reasonable accommodations/support throughout, please contact us at workwithus@qvcgrp.com for assistance.

If provided, salary ranges are a general guideline only, and actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, and geographic location as well as business and market conditions.
